overview: SEAdLINNNG is a Japanese women's professional wrestling promotion created in 2015 by former World Wonder Ring Stardom wrestler and co-founder Nanae Takahashi. Their roster is predominantly made up of outside talent from other promotions such as Ice Ribbon, ChocoPro/Gatoh Move Pro Wrestling, Marvelous That's Women Pro Wrestling, World Woman Pro-Wrestling Diana and even Stardom at times, as well as veterans, freelancers and their own dojo trainees.
